# Vendored UI package

`falkordb-ui-chat-0.1.0.tgz` is built from FalkorDB/falkordb-ui commit
`a678348206ddaac40fec6738a9fe724f3b8c2a2c`, package
`web-components/chat`. The package is documented upstream but was not
available from npm when T12 was implemented. The tarball is the unmodified
output of `npm pack` after running the package build.

Upstream: https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-ui
License: MIT
